name: search_memory
description: ⚡ PRIORITY TOOL - CHECK FIRST! KEYWORD/ENTITY SEARCH using FTS5 with BM25 ranking. USE THIS BEFORE action tools when user asks about anything they might have previously configured, set up, or told you about. Searches stored information by entity names, keywords, or technical terms. Examples: checking server status, finding configurations, locating project details. ALWAYS try this first before execute_bash, query_service_logs, or api_call. For conceptual questions, use semantic_recall instead. FOR VERIFICATION QUESTIONS (e.g., 'did you save X?', 'is Y in memory?', 'verify Z was stored'): After searching, explicitly report whether matching entries were found, what they contain, and their relevance - don't just silently use the result. IMPORTANT: If no results are found, clearly state this to the user rather than assuming information doesn't exist - consider trying semantic_recall as a fallback. SEARCH STRATEGY: Use multiple query variations (synonyms, related terms, broader/narrower concepts) if initial search returns no results or irrelevant matches.
